description: Paired comparisons on the rebased runtime. Workloads and iterations retained; compiler input lists are revision specific. Experimental constant selection retains packed values and GMP import/export.

summary.note: Ratios above 1 are slower; initial flags, repeats and pooled medians retained. Report real regressions rather than hiding them in aggregate speedups.

dispatch_methodology: The initial sweep used different library path spellings. All cases showing a slowdown over 5 percent were rebuilt with --lib lib on both sides and repeated for 100 pairs; initial results retained, not pooled across the path change.

supplementary_driver_sources.dispatch-repeat.py:
import hashlib,json,os,re,statistics,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('tests/out/intinf/rebase/final');perf=out/'performance';deadline=time.monotonic()+28800
while 'PASS compiler specialization repeats' not in (out/'design-compiler-repeats.log').read_text():
 if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise SystemExit('preceding measurements did not finish')
 time.sleep(10)
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{min(os.sched_getaffinity(0))})
load=lambda p:json.loads(Path(p).read_text());sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
first=load(perf/'dispatch/report.json')
names=[n for n,w in first['workloads'].items() if any(r>1.05 for r in w['ratios_to_baseline'].values())]
command=['python3','tests/intinf/dispatch.py','--baseline-root',str(Path.cwd().parent/'gmp-master-baseline'),'--samples','100','--out',str(perf/'dispatch-repeat')]
for n in names:command+=['--workload',n]
(perf/'dispatch-repeat-command.json').write_text(json.dumps(command,indent=2)+'\n')
print('START normalized boundary repeats',names,flush=True)
with (perf/'dispatch-repeat.log').open('w') as log:subprocess.run(command,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,timeout=3600)
repeat=load(perf/'dispatch-repeat/report.json');summary={}
for n,w in repeat['workloads'].items():
 assert w['source_sha256']==first['workloads'][n]['source_sha256']
 summary[n]={'initial':first['workloads'][n]['ratios_to_baseline'],'repeat':w['ratios_to_baseline']}
 counts={}
 for mode in ['gmp','sml','baseline']:
  directory=Path.cwd().parent/'gmp-master-baseline' if mode=='baseline' else Path.cwd()
  rbc=perf/'dispatch-repeat'/(n+('-baseline' if mode=='baseline' else '')+'.rbc')
  command=[str(directory/'bin/runevm'),'--count',*(['--intinf='+mode] if mode!='baseline' else []),str(rbc.resolve())]
  p=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180,check=True)
  assert p.stdout.split('\n',1)[1]==w['expected']
  prefix=perf/'dispatch-repeat'/(n+'-'+mode+'-counts')
  prefix.with_suffix('.command.json').write_text(json.dumps(command)+'\n')
  prefix.with_suffix('.stdout').write_text(p.stdout);prefix.with_suffix('.stderr').write_text(p.stderr)
  counts[mode]=p.stderr
 summary[n]['counts']=counts
(perf/'dispatch-repeat-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
print('PASS normalized boundary repeats',flush=True)

design.description:
Measure runtime backend selection against constant-selection experiments.

These test-only Basis copies retain packed values, limits, normalization and
GMP import/export. They cannot test the cost of that representation against
persistent GMP objects, and must not be used as deployable replacements.
Compiler controls compile the same normal input library so output hashes agree;
they do not remove the cost of parsing the fallback source definitions.
